class_id: a field written at row creation gets no field_sources row from the create call, and no later writer in the cycle backfills it
feature: scraper/src/services/data-consolidation-orchestrator.ts (~lines 385-392) -- the create branch that calls ipoRepository.create()
symptom: the create branch of the consolidation orchestrator writes the new row's columns without recording a field_sources provenance row for each one, unlike every other write path in the same cycle. A later writer in the same cycle then adds provenance for SOME of the created columns (whatever it itself is responsible for) but not others, so the row ends up with partial provenance and no single writer is at fault for the gap -- the identity/name column is the one observed missing, because no downstream writer in the cycle claims it either. Universal shape: any column set exclusively by a create-time call that itself skips provenance, and never re-touched by a provenance-writing step afterward, has no field_sources row and none will ever appear unless the row is re-processed by a writer that covers that column.
first_seen: 2026-09-26 -- #1196, read-only on ipodhan_staging 20:33 IST. 396 IPOs have a company_name; 47 have zero field_sources rows for field_name='companyName'. Of IPOs created in the last 14 days, lotSize has provenance on 32/32 and openDate on 40/40, but companyName only on 40/46. Six IPOs created in one Chittorgarh discovery cycle (2026-09-25 18:45 UTC) each got provenance rows about 11s later for issueSize/issueType/sector, never for companyName.
